description: Rows of an x402 market table, $0.0002 a row: listing history (each Bazaar listing's category, method, latest price, first and last week seen, weeks listed and price changes) or survival cohorts (each week's new listings by category and how many were still listed one to four weeks on). Filter by category, page with offset, JSON or CSV. Row counts are free at /v1/rows/contents. rows picks the most rows sent, and the price. Price: rows=5 $0.001; rows=50 $0.01; rows=500 $0.10; rows=5000 $1.00, in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call; the 402 states the one price of what the arguments ask for. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges that price to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

format.description: Optional: json (columns and rows, the default) or csv as well
format.title: Format

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

listed.description: Optional, listing history only: listed now, or gone
listed.title: Listed

offset.description: Optional: skip this many rows (the answer gives the next offset)
offset.title: Offset

rows.description: The most rows to send, which sets the price: 5 for $0.001, 50 for $0.01, 500 for $0.10, 5000 for $1.00
rows.title: Rows

set.description: Which table. listing_history: Each listing seen in the weekly Bazaar snapshots: host, category, method, latest USD price, first and last week seen, weeks listed, price changes and whether it is listed now. survival_cohorts: Each week's new listings by category, and how many were still listed one to four weeks on.
set.title: Set
